payload.reason: The evidence provides specific examples of how the approach improves interpretability through the use of keywords and crowd-sourced expectations, demonstrating its effectiveness in model training and transparency.

claims.text: The approach improves model training transparency by using crowd-sourced keywords to provide human-understandable explanations for the model's predictions.
Empirical results show that the approach significantly enhances model performance, which indirectly supports its interpretability by demonstrating the effectiveness of the keywords used.
The cost-effectiveness of using crowdsourcing for keyword discovery over traditional labeling methods further highlights the interpretability benefits of the approach.
